sub_active_claim: Bounded synthetic architecture Discovery of hard top-k router perturbation churn; no formal authority and no dependency for MAIN.
why_independent_of_main: MAIN has no admitted object/identity/branch/STARTED/workflow. Probe uses only synthetic linear routers and synthetic module-state vectors and does not touch any candidate, blocker, successor or consumed line.
main_work_explicitly_avoided: fresh-object admission and primary candidate selection
future H7/causal-credit mechanism or comparator construction
question_or_hypothesis: Can small perturbations near hard top-k router boundaries create discrete selected-set churn and O(1) pooled-state changes, with boundary density increasing as module count grows at fixed k=4; and is the churn fully reducible to ordinary linear top-k hyperplane geometry?

implementation_or_experiment_performed.method: Synthetic Gaussian linear router; exact analytic first top-k crossing radius along a random perturbation direction; compare hard selected-set turnover and pooled-state jump with smooth softmax-weighted pooling.

observations.interpretation: Raw hard top-k selected-set churn is exactly reduced to ordinary linear hyperplane crossing geometry in this synthetic setting.

what_would_falsify_or_reduce_it: On a prospectively specified DEV-only trained SparseRoutingModel study, reject/reduce if delayed state/output divergence is fully predicted by router margin plus selected-set turnover and is not meaningfully larger than a privilege-matched smooth or margin-matched baseline, or if realistic DEV margins make turnover negligible.

ordinary_branch_ci.scientific_relevance: repository CI only; not formal/scientific execution

blockers: No formal SUB lane/fallback is allocated; Discovery only.
Any cycle-2 DEV architecture study requires fresh Analyst acceptance/promotion and prospective choices before execution.
completion_target: Select and execute one bounded high-information Discovery target, record NON_EVIDENTIARY observations and reduction test, and hand it to Evidence Analyst for promotion/rejection without touching MAIN or formal one-way surfaces.
proposed_handoff_to_analyst: PROMOTE_TO_ARCHITECTURE_STUDY if a DEV-only recurrent/persistence follow-up is judged useful. Do not promote raw top-k churn as novelty: cycle 1 already reduces selection turnover exactly to ordinary top-k boundary geometry. A future cycle should ask only whether recurrent persistent-state dynamics create delayed amplification beyond that ordinary boundary effect.
